Class RawCachingGlyphStore

Namespace: osu.Framework.IO.Stores
Assembly: osu.Framework.dll

A glyph store which caches font sprite sheets as raw pixels to disk on first use.

public class RawCachingGlyphStore : GlyphStore, IResourceStore<TextureUpload>, IGlyphStore, IResourceStore<CharacterGlyph>, IDisposable

Remarks

This results in memory efficient lookups with good performance on solid state backed devices. Consider osu.Framework.IO.Stores.TimedExpiryGlyphStore if disk IO is limited and memory usage is not an issue.
